tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are a university student who has recently moved into a new apartment. You have noticed some issues with the apartment. You want to inform your landlord, Mr. Thompson, about these problems.
bullets: Describe the issues you have encountered in the apartment.
Explain how conditions negatively affect your studies.
Request that he make arrangements to address these issues soon.
tasks.subject: Request for apartment repairs
tasks.sample:
Dear Mr. Thompson,

I recently moved into apartment 4B and have noticed several problems. The kitchen faucet leaks whenever I turn it on, the bedroom heater does not warm the room, and one of the living-room windows will not close completely.

These conditions are making it hard to study. The dripping faucet keeps me awake, the cold room makes it difficult to sit at my desk, and the open window is noisy at night.

Could you please arrange for repairs as soon as possible? I am available most afternoons this week if a technician needs access to the apartment.

Thank you for your help.

Best regards,
Alex Chen
tasks.analysis: 邮件须写清公寓问题、对学习的影响，并请求尽快安排维修。称呼 Mr. Thompson，主题 Request for apartment repairs。
tasks.title: Apartment Repairs

tasks.instruction: Write a discussion response. An effective response contains at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: We've been discussing the impact of different teaching methods on student learning. Some educational experts believe that project-based learning is the most effective way to learn. Do you think project-based learning is beneficial for students? Why or why not?

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: I believe project-based learning is highly beneficial for students. It encourages critical thinking, collaboration, and problem-solving skills. Students can apply what they learn in real-world scenarios, which helps them retain information better.

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: In my opinion, project-based learning might not work for every student. Some students may find it challenging to manage long-term projects and prefer traditional teaching methods like lectures and exams. It's important to have a balance of different teaching approaches.

tasks.sample: I agree with Paul that project-based learning can be highly beneficial, but I also share Claire's caution. When students design an experiment or build a prototype, they have to plan, revise, and explain their work. That process builds the collaboration and problem-solving skills Paul mentions, and it often helps ideas stick longer than a lecture alone. At the same time, not every student is ready to manage a long project. Some need clearer checkpoints, shorter tasks, or a mix of exams and projects so they do not fall behind. The most effective classrooms use projects for application and traditional teaching for foundations. Project-based learning is beneficial when teachers provide structure, not when it is the only method.
tasks.analysis: 需表明立场并回应 Paul 与 Claire。较好答法：肯定项目学习的迁移与协作价值，同时承认需要结构与传统教学平衡。
tasks.title: Project-Based Learning
